description: The scroll-built montage: a mosaic on sand whose tiles reveal their slice of the image underneath in a random order proportional to progress through a 240vh track; empty tiles carry random charcoal tints and a faint roundel emboss. Underneath is one of the montage's three image slots — the suppliers' montages — chosen at random per visit; when the visitor scrolls back above the montage and every tile has closed, the next takes its place unseen, so the next reveal shows a different image (Mark, 11 Sep 2026). Six rows; the columns follow the image's aspect so the tiles stay square.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: Six rows; columns follow the image aspect so the tiles stay square (a 2:1 montage → 12×6; a 7:5 photograph → 8×6)

properties.name: images
